mapper.select: SELECT ci.id AS classId, ci.class_name AS className, ROUND(AVG(s.score), 2) AS avgScore, (SELECT ROUND(AVG(sub_score), 2) FROM ( SELECT s2.score AS sub_score, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s2.score) AS rn, COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt FROM score s2 INNER JOIN student st2 ON s2.student_id = st2.id WHERE st2.class_id = #{classId} AND s2.course_id = #{courseId} ) sub WHERE sub.rn IN (FLOOR((sub.cnt + 1) / 2), CEIL((sub.cnt + 1) / 2))) AS medianScore, ROUND(STDDEV(s.score), 2) AS stdDev, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN s.score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.id), 2) AS passRate FROM score s INNER JOIN student st ON s.student_id = st.id INNER JOIN class_info ci ON st.class_id = ci.id WHERE st.class_id = #{classId} AND s.course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT t.student_id, st.name AS studentName, c.course_name AS courseName, c.id AS courseId, t.prev_score AS previousScore, t.current_score AS currentScore, (t.prev_score - t.current_score) AS dropAmount, t.semester FROM ( SELECT s.student_id, s.course_id, s.score AS current_score, LAG(s.score) OVER (PARTITION BY s.student_id, s.course_id ORDER BY s.semester) AS prev_score, s.semester FROM score s ) t INNER JOIN student st ON t.student_id = st.id INNER JOIN course c ON t.course_id = c.id WHERE t.prev_score IS NOT NULL AND (t.prev_score - t.current_score) > 15 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM score_alert sa WHERE sa.student_id = t.student_id AND sa.course_id = t.course_id AND sa.semester = t.semester )
